spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}, {@hit 7} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Hellish Rebuke
headerEntries: The cultist casts {@spell Hellish Rebuke|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes three Pact Axe attacks.

action.name: Pact Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Fire damage.
